## This is the right place if you want...

- Help deploying VaultRAG **Enterprise** (SSO, reverse proxy / TLS, air-gapped installs, Kubernetes, GPU sizing)
- A **custom integration** (SharePoint, Confluence, S3/MinIO, network shares, internal ticketing, your IdP)
- Features that exist only in the Enterprise edition (see the comparison table in the README)
- Priority, direct, or SLA-backed support

## Already an Enterprise customer?

Please do **not** use public issues for your license. Contact us through the private support channel that came with your purchase (Whop dashboard -> *VaultRAG Enterprise* -> *Support*).

## Not a customer yet?

**Get VaultRAG Enterprise - one-time $149:**
**https://whop.com/checkout/YOUR_PRODUCT_ID**

You get the full source code of the Enterprise edition, so most integration work can be done by your own engineers. For anything beyond that, use the private contact below.

**Private contact (consulting, custom work, procurement questions):** `enterprise@YOUR_DOMAIN.com`

## Looking for help with the free Lite edition?

Community support for Lite is best-effort. Please open a **Bug report** or start a **Discussion** instead of this template.
